mentions.name: SkyMap
mentions.description: A browser-based open source universe explorer that gathers, parses, and visualizes publicly available scientific data in real-time. It includes galaxy survey visualizations, hi-res tiled Earth and Mars imagery, a Gaia star field with 16 million stars, a Milky Way renderer, and more.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://skymap.rulkens.com
A browser based open source universe explorer. I'm in between jobs currently and finally took time to work on my passion project. It started with just visualizing some galaxy surveys, but it got a little out of hand and now includes everything from hi-res tiled earth/mars, Gaia star field (16M stars), a milky way renderer and much more.
mentions.author: thereallex
